text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- The mass-privatisation programe will be extended to the first half of next year.
- Romania's Post-Privatisation Fund (FRPP) is an opportunity for small investors. FRPP has 44 million ECU for investments.
- Another nine companies have lodged applications for entry to the Bucharest Bourse.

- Communications Ministry says the MobiFon consortium, led by Airtouch Communications Inc and TIW, has won one of the two licences for the GSM cellular phone system in Romania offered in a tender. The other winner was the MobilRom consortium led by FRance telecom.
ROMANIA LIBERA

- A lack of interest from the present government generated tensions between capital market operators. The RASDAQ over-the-counter market is accused by the Bourse of illegal competition. Top Bourse officials say market regulator CNVM has permitted RASDAQ to do anything it wants, in comparison with its over-regulation of the Bourse.
- Report on bank fraud at Banca Romana de Dezvoltare.
ZIUA
- Romania's central bank will intervene on the domestic forex market only if energy imports are in danger.

- State energy holding RENEL will feel the effects of leu depreciation over the next thre months. The holding registered deficits of 600 billion lei. For electoral reasons Vacaroiu's cabinet mantained an artificially low energy price.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- The shortage of gas cylinders is due to low prices in the Romanian market. The solution is more butane imports.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Former tennis player Ilie Nastase said Romania's Social Democracy Party (PDSR) is not a reformist party and three quarters of its members should be replaced with younger people.
- The leaders of Social Democrat Union asked Ion Iliescu to withdraw in public a corruption accusation made in last electoral debate on state television.
- Teodor Melescanu, Romania's Foreign minister said in an interview ethnic Hungarians were no danger to Romania.
- Presidential candidate Ion Iliescu needed oxygen in the intermision of the last electoral debate on state television.
ADEVARUL
- The newspaper reports on electoral debate on state television between Emil Constantinescu and Ion Iliescu.
- France expells 31 illegal Romanian immigrants.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- All major Romanian state and private television stations will have special analysis on the results of the second round of presidential ellections.
CRONICA ROMANA
- The newspaper present briefly the electoral programes of Emil Constantinescu and Ion Iliescu.
- They also reports on "last night of electoral war" broadcast by state television.
- Democratic Convention wil sue all people who engaged in electoral fraud.
- Ion Ratiu, top oficial of National Peasant Party, does not exclude the possibility he could be a minister in the next cabinet.
CURIERUL NATIONAL

- Most Romanian orphans adopted were taken by American citizens. The official statistics show more than 1800 children were adopted by americans in first part of this year. ($=3,472 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
